module: Flowgraph node "Garage Tutorial Util" (category repeat_instant, ui color/icon), helper for the garage tutorial. Bool outputs: parkedInGarage (an inventory vehicle is in the nearest garage and its speed is < 0.25 m/s) and isRepaired (the player's vehicle does not need repair according to insurance). Every second of simulated time, updates the part state of the player's vehicle (not when on foot).
notes: Uses career_modules_inventory and career_modules_insurance_insurance: requires career.
The code reads map.objects[objId] without a nil check.

_executionStarted.desc: Timer at 0 when the graph starts.

work.desc: Every frame: computes parkedInGarage and isRepaired; every second, calls career_modules_inventory.updatePartConditions for the player's vehicle if they are not walking.
